tool_input.command:
cat >> db/schema.ts <<'EOF'

export const comments = sqliteTable('comments', {
  id: integer('id').primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
  postId: integer('post_id')
    .notNull()
    .references(() => posts.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  userId: integer('user_id')
    .notNull()
    .references(() => users.id),
  body: text('body').notNull(),
  createdAt: text('created_at').notNull().$defaultFn(() => new Date().toISOString()),
})

export const commentReports = sqliteTable(
  'comment_reports',
  {
    id: integer('id').primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
    commentId: integer('comment_id')
      .notNull()
      .references(() => comments.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
    userId: integer('user_id')
      .notNull()
      .references(() => users.id),
    createdAt: text('created_at').notNull().$defaultFn(() => new Date().toISOString()),
  },
  (table) => [unique('comment_reports_comment_user_unique').on(table.commentId, table.userId)],
)
EOF
sed -i '' "1s/.*/import { sqliteTable, integer, text, unique } from '@guren\/orm\/drizzle\/sqlite'/" db/schema.ts
bun run db:make -- --help 2>&1 | tail -20; git status --short

result:
Comments, deleting, reporting and hiding are all in place. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass, but the tests I added only cover the two guest redirects. I did not run the signed-in flows (delete, 403, report, hide, cascade on post delete) or the UI, so those are untested.

- **Storage:** `db/schema.ts` has new `comments` and `comment_reports` tables. The report table has a unique (`comment_id`, `user_id`) pair. The migration is `db/migrations/20260929134110_comments/`, and the tests applied it.
- **Endpoints:** `routes/web.ts` adds `POST /posts/:id/comments`, `DELETE /comments/:id` and `POST /comments/:id/report`, all behind the existing `auth` middleware, so a guest is redirected to `/login`.
    - **Create:** a body outside 1–2000 characters fails validation the same way an invalid post title does. The body is trimmed first, so a whitespace-only comment is rejected.
    - **Delete:** only the comment's author or the post's author can delete; anyone else gets 403.
    - **Report:** always returns 204, and a repeat report by the same user still counts once.
- **Post page:** `PostController.show` now passes `comments` (oldest first, `{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }`). A comment with three or more different reporters is left out of the page but stays in the table.
- **Post delete:** `PostController.destroy` removes the post's comments and their reports explicitly. I did this because SQLite may not enforce the cascade unless foreign keys are switched on.
- **UI:** `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx` lists the comments, with a comment box when signed in, Delete for the comment's author and the post's author, and Report for signed-in viewers.

The new code is in `CommentController.ts`, `Models/Comment.ts` and `Validators/CommentValidator.ts`. I re-ran codegen, so the `.guren/*.gen.ts` files changed too.
